QuestInfo.name: File Under Incomplete
QuestInfo.0: MBI Agent Falcon is still snooping around the old Haunted House, even after I helped him find some of the Paranormal Activity Report Pages!  I wonder why... maybe he still needs help.
QuestInfo.1: Looks like MBI Agent Falcon spoke too soon... 50 pages led him to the wrong, uh, dead guy... but he thinks that if I collect #b100#k more of them, he'll be able to catch Mr. Bones for sure!  Whew... 100 pages.  I wonder how many pages in total were in his original report.
QuestInfo.2: I tracked down all of the 100 more #t4031764#s#k Agent Falcon requested!  Now he can finally go track Mr. Bones... I hope.

0.0: Oh, hey there... it's you again. Er... you wouldn't happen to have some free time on your hands, would you?\r\n\r\n#L0##bDidn't I help you find Mr. Bones? What are you still doing around here?#l#k
0.1:
With the information I had, I tracked down Mr. Bones' hiding place in the house. Well, uh... more accurately... what I thought was his hiding place. I found a Mr. Bones... but he turned out to be an old (and rather crotchety) skeleton, rather than the crafty ghost I'm looking for. <Cough>... He wasn't too happy that I woke him up. Nasty fellow.

#L0##bI can see your bruises.#l#k
#L1##bI already helped you! Can't you do your own job?!#l#k
0.2: Yes... unfortunately, they're as painful as they look. Can you help me make sure I don't make the same mistake again?

1.1: Um... well... I guess that's one way to look at it. Hmph... I thought civilians were always happy to help out on official Paranormal Investigation business.  Well, if you do, you know where to find me.

yes.0: Guess I was a tad bit hasty in my assumptions. I've realized that with only 50-some pages my file is still rather incomplete. Plus... uh... I tend to doodle a lot when I'm nervous, so a lot of the report pages you found are... um... just my drawings of ghosts and aliens. To be extra sure this time, let's get me #b100#k more #bParanormal Activity Report Pages#k. That should do the trick.

no.0: Hmph... I thought civilians were always happy to help out on official Paranormal Investigation business.  Well, if you do, you know where to find me.

1.0: You got them? Fantastic! Here, let me have a look! Hmmm... By triangulating the data from Mr. Bones' movements from Page 407 with this page from his psychological profile, we can infer that... Yes! That makes sense! And then, if we cross-reference that with this chart from Page 75, we can deduce... Yes! Of course! Why didn't I think of that before?! Mr. Bones must be at- Oh, sorry, I almost forgot about you in my excitement!

item.0: Hmmm... not quite #b100 Paranormal Activity Report Pages#k yet. Like I said, I don't want to make the same mistake twice... getting beaten up by a bony old skeleton really hurts! Please keep looking!
